name: smwgraphics-densetsu-no-stafy-2-stage-2
title: Densetsu no Stafy 2 - Stage 2-3 (Night)
description:
A very charming and simple background from Densetsu no Stafy 2. It's a great fit for calm area or night levels close to the sea. BG Scrolling should NONE, NONE.

UPDATE: Minor optimizations and more accuracy the source material, at the expense of using some extra colors in palette row 1. Reripped from scratch.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
